items.title: DoorDash (DASH) Becomes Official On Demand Delivery Partner Across North America

The multiyear agreement covers both the United States and Canada and includes exclusivity within the on demand delivery category. DoorDash branding will appear during nationally televised NHL games, major league events and across league digital platforms throughout the season.
